_comment: Questions YOU have verified by hand. This file is the only place a human judgement enters the
evaluation — everything else is derived from the corpus, which means it can only ever check that
the right documents come back, never that an answer is legally correct.
To add one: ask Lex the question, read the answer, and if it is right note WHICH pièces it should
have relied on. Put their ids in expectedDocumentIds. The suite then fails the day retrieval stops
surfacing them — which is how a silent regression becomes visible.
Get a document id from the documents view URL, or:
psql -c "SELECT id, filename FROM lex_documents WHERE filename ILIKE '%conclusions%'"
id must be unique and stable; prefix it 'verified:' so it never collides with a derived case.
